lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs vary in diameter and are most prominent in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a high density of small, randomly distributed high-luminance blobs throughout its visible surface.
